verdict.rationale: TrueLayer's own docs describe an official TrueLayer MCP server for Claude that lets the assistant perform banking and payment operations, and the probe confirms this documentation page exists. The docs name a concrete tool, `create-truelayer-payment-link`, showing the server exposes payment actions to an agent. Missing for 10: evidence of the full tool set beyond payment links, setup and authentication details for connecting the server, documented support for MCP clients other than Claude, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
